rig: 4× MI50, PCIe 3.0 x16, no P2P, layer-split serial PP
harness: examples/decode_profile + examples/ab_decode (sequential subproc, disjoint GPU pairs)
stack: mmvq_q8_0_gate_up_dp4a (extended: asymmetric n_rows, applied to shexp, ssm_α+β, attn_qkv+attn_gate, attn_k+attn_v)

wall_clock.notes_on_comparison: Apples-to-apples comparison is Mesh<2> vs Mesh<2>. Initial 92.6% figure compared our-Mesh<2> (53.72) against llama.cpp's-Mesh<4> (58.04) and was misleading. llama.cpp runs faster on Mesh<2> than on Mesh<4> (62.14 vs 58.04) because fewer PP stages = less hand-off overhead. Corrected gap: 15.7% on equal-rank topology.
wall_clock.measurement_method: 5 runs × 128 decode steps after 4 warmup, mean ± σ

kernel_family_breakdown.note: sum over 21 forwards × 2 ranks = 42 rank-forwards, rocprof --hip-trace, 64 measured steps

MMVQ-Q4_K-MoE.note: Pure DP4A win on inner loop

GDN-core.note: Noise-level; no GDN-core change this session

hipStreamSynchronize.note: 58% reduction in avg sync wait — faster kernels resolve waits sooner

negative_findings.note: Levers tried and rejected — kept for reference so we don't repeat

cast_f32_f16_fusion_into_mmvq.reason: llama.cpp also has standalone cast; no structural advantage to chase
cast_f32_f16_fusion_into_mmvq.expected_win: ~1% — too small to justify touching every MMVQ epilogue

hip_graphs.reason: llama.cpp gates USE_CUDA_GRAPH on Ampere+; disabled on gfx906

sync_elimination.reason: Removed 2 syncs in forward.rs + cluster.rs peer_copy; no wall-clock gain at Mesh<2> serial PP because syncs happen during other rank's compute window

multi_row_Q8_0.reason: llama.cpp's calc_rows_per_block returns 1 for GCN at ncols_dst=1 — not a lever they use either

f32_to_q8_1_direct_quantize.reason: F16-to-Q8_1 kernel uses packed fp16 max-reduction which F32-to-Q8_1 can't; saving 1 launch costs more per-element. Net -1%

Q4_K_MoE_gate_up_further_tuning.note: Still #2 largest family. Inner loop has 4 dp4a (2 data + 2 sum-of-u) — could try VDR=4 equivalent.

full_attn_Q_K_V_three_way_fusion.note: attn_q [8192] + K [512] + V [512] — very asymmetric; extending current 2-way kernel to 3-way. ~5 full-attn layers per rank, small absolute win.

mesh_1_via_q3_quant.note: Structural: Q3_K_S variant of Qwen3.6-35B would fit 16GB → no PP. Needs Q-quality cert (V1.7.8).

GDN_epilogue_cluster_fusion.note: Fuse rmsnorm_f32 + silu_f32 + scale_f32 + l2_norm + quantize cluster per GDN layer. 5 kernels → 1. pending llama.cpp comparison (V1.7.6 sub-task #113).

close_llama_cpp_gap_analysis.note: Remaining 4.32 tok/s = 1.4 ms/token. Likely some combination of: slightly better llama.cpp kernels (compiled w/ different optim), C++ vs Rust FFI overhead, graph-level op merging in ggml scheduler. Diminishing returns from single-lever ports; may need orchestration-level work to close.
